candidates.title: Recovery Operational Pilot Harness
candidates.problem_or_opportunity: The verified v1 extractor and semantic v2 candidate still need a real-corpus, connector-aware, transactional end-to-end pilot harness before semantic recovery can be promoted.
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Bind immutable corpus intake, v1 extraction, semantic/project partitioning, typed claim verification, GitHub/Drive evidence adapters, chat-only candidate persistence, transactional readback, idempotent rerun, completion gate and next-action handoff into one candidate pilot harness.

candidates.next_action: Implement bounded harness and run adversarial synthetic fixtures; then run first genuine large transcript without promoting candidate semantics beforehand.

candidates.title: Research Cycle Dedupe + Information-Gain Gate
candidates.problem_or_opportunity: Parallel 32→64 research cycles can generate duplicate mechanisms, stale-base branches and more integration debt than evidence gain.
candidates.proposed_mechanism: Before another meta-research cycle, evaluate scope overlap, new evidence, unique unimplemented mechanisms, external dependency, integration queue, invention queue and expected information gain. Default HOLD when the decisive dependency is external and proposed work mostly restates existing candidates. Direct Founder instruction may override scheduling but never upgrades evidence class.
protected_authorities: Founder may explicitly switch focus or authorize another cycle
Story-first priority when Founder has not switched focus
candidates.next_action: Pilot on current open 32→64 branches and compare KEEP/MERGE/HOLD/PRUNE recommendations against manual review.
candidates.hold_trigger: No independent pilot showing reduced duplication without suppressing useful distinct work
